7b1a41dca0aca92bd9d7739f304abafc.overview: Returning home from a shopping trip to a nearby town, bored suburban housewife Laura Jesson is thrown by happenstance into an acquaintance with virtuous doctor Alec Harvey. Their casual friendship soon develops during their weekly visits into something more emotionally fulfilling than either expected, and they must wrestle with the potential havoc their deepening relationship would have on their lives and the lives of those they love.
7b1a41dca0aca92bd9d7739f304abafc.tagline: A story of the most precious moments in a woman's life!

7b341d794ce6a75f2ff7f7fdf26a2001.overview: Anna Kalman is an accomplished actress who has given up hope of finding the man of her dreams. While talking about this subject with her sister, in walks Philip Adams and she realizes that this is the charming, smart, and handsome man she has been waiting for.
7b341d794ce6a75f2ff7f7fdf26a2001.tagline: How dare he make love to me - And not be a married man!

7b5d8788bfc85ee0d1ff02d9a1ea1004.overview: An unemployed Brit vents his rage on unsuspecting strangers as he embarks on a nocturnal London odyssey.

7b6e183095684c24ff6880652f660e5c.overview: Jep Gambardella has seduced his way through the lavish nightlife of Rome for decades, but after his 65th birthday and a shock from the past, Jep looks past the nightclubs and parties to find a timeless landscape of absurd, exquisite beauty.

7b71c844e4a43feeb3798cc3f4463597.overview: Set in the Clapham district of south London, England, the film is inspired by true events. The paths of several men intersect during a dramatic thirty-six hours in which their lives are changed forever.
7b71c844e4a43feeb3798cc3f4463597.tagline: Their lives will never be the same.

7b986a58e6816177c30a7a62cc12bac0.overview: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.
7b986a58e6816177c30a7a62cc12bac0.tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.

7bc13d90413e1c76ad0fd6cc5b4976a8.overview: In 19th century New York high society, a young lawyer falls in love with a woman separated from her husband, while he is engaged to the woman's cousin.
7bc13d90413e1c76ad0fd6cc5b4976a8.tagline: In a world of tradition. In an age of innocence. They dared to break the rules.

7be2c129ca7723f5ec5b6130096ee3b1.overview: Queen Elizabeth I visits late 1970s England to find a depressing landscape where life has changed since her time.
7be2c129ca7723f5ec5b6130096ee3b1.tagline: Sex, drugs and punk rock. Add violence and time travel and you have Jubilee.
